component.name: Edgepad
component.summary: Native Linux Touchpad Edge Gesture Manager

description.p: Edgepad turns the unused physical edges of your laptop touchpad into customizable swipe zones for hardware control. Swipe up or down on the left edge to adjust display brightness, or on the right edge to control system audio volume.

ul.li: Native Qt 6 and KDE Plasma Wayland graphical settings manager
Reliable Linux /dev/uinput physical keyboard event emulation (KEY_BRIGHTNESSUP, KEY_VOLUMEDOWN, etc.)
Passive and non-intrusive multi-touch routing: center touchpad clicks and scrolling remain 100% unaffected
Live diagnostic tester with simulated actions and real-time telemetry
User-level systemd daemon management and start-at-login integration
